title: Ceti Lacera
extract:
The Ceti Lacera is a variant of the  Lacera that sports improved critical chance and attack speed with some expense to status chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Electricity damage.
Slam Attack deals  Electricity damage.
Innate  polarity.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Defiled Snapdragon and  Tainted Hydra (Conclave only) stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average damage × attack speed (279.93)
High block angle (60°)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high status chance (40.00%)
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average total damage (432)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Above average damage × attack speed (559.87)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high status chance (45.00%)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average total damage (648)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Above average damage × attack speed (839.80)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high status chance (45.00%)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Below average crit chance (20.00%)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Ceti Lacera (Normal Attack), compared to  Lacera (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Higher base critical chance (20.00% vs. 5.00%)
Lower base status chance (40.00% vs. 45.00%)
Higher attack speed (1.080x animation speed vs. 0.917x animation speed)
Higher Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 7)
Lower disposition (●●●●○ (1.20x) vs. ●●●●● (1.31x))

Acquisition
Ceti Lacera's blueprint is obtainable from limited-time events:
Ceti Lacera was first introduced in Operation: Scarlet Spear, purchasable from Little Duck for 20,000  Scarlet Credits.
Operation: Orphix Venom sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Father for 2,000  Phasic Cells.
Operation: Gargoyle's Cry sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Vigil Jahu Gargoyle for 3  Grotesque Splinter.
The October 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 Nights of Naberus sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Daughter for 125  Mother Tokens.
Operation: Belly of the Beast sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Ordis for 15  Volatile Motes. Has a purchase limit of 1.
Operation: Eight Claw sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Dominus Thrax for 9  Dominus Aureus. Has a purchase limit of 1.
Operation: Blood of Perita sold Ceti Lacera's blueprint from Roathe for 20 Marks of Valiance. Has a purchase limit of 1.
The blueprint can be traded between players.

Notes
When combining elements the innate  Electricity damage is added last, unless another mod adds this type.
The fourth attack of the stanceless/Claws of the Drake combo as well as the Heavy Attack use the whip to ragdoll and pull enemies towards the player.

Trivia
Ceti is the plural form of Cetus, a Latin term for "sea monster".
As a reward for the Scarlet Spear event, it likely takes its name from Tau Ceti, one of the closest stars to Earth.
This is currently the only Ceti-type weapon.
